```{r library}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r create dataset, echo=FALSE}

survival_data <- data.frame(
  time = c(0.00, 1.39, 4.07, 4.76, 5.89),
  n_at_risk = c(4, 4, 3, 2, 1),
  events = c(0, 1, 1, 1, 1),
  surv_percent = c(100, 75, 50, 25, 0)
)

```


# Questions

## Cumulative Percent Survival vs time
```{r q9}

ggplot(survival_data, aes(x = time, y = surv_percent)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "Time (years)",
       y = "Cumulative Percent Survival",
       title = "Cumulative Percent Survival vs Time",
       caption = "H. Motulsky, Intuitive Biostatistics, 3rd Ed (2014), page 44")

```
